cardOverview.overviewText: The Union Bank NEXTERIA Credit Card is a super-premium RuPay EKAA metal travel-and-lifestyle card offering unlimited domestic & international airport lounge access, premium hotel and concierge perks, and robust travel-related benefits aimed at affluent users.
